films.desc_en: A sophisticated showcase of a custom-made modern kitchen bringing joy to a homeowner.
films.music: Warm, inspiring acoustic guitar and soft piano, 95 bpm
vo_mk: Сонувате за совршен простор во домот?
Време е да го претворите во реалност.
Врвна изработка со најквалитетно дрво.
Секој детаљ создаден само за вас.
Вашиот дом, ваша лична приказна.

shots.kf: Woman in her 40s, short dark hair, wearing a white linen blouse, stands gracefully near a large window overlooking the scenic Mount Vodno in Skopje. The room is bathed in soft, warm morning light. Captured with a 50mm lens, cinematic composition, featuring a pastel and earthy color palette, highly detailed and photorealistic.
shots.motion: The woman slowly turns her head towards the camera with a gentle smile as the camera slowly pushes in.

shots.kf: Close-up of smooth, premium oak wood grain being illuminated by warm, dappled sunlight streaming through a window. Dust motes float peacefully in the air. Shot with a macro lens, shallow depth of field, rich warm amber and brown tones, cinematic studio lighting, exceptionally photorealistic textures.
shots.motion: Sunlight slowly shifts across the wood surface, highlighting the grain, while the camera subtly pans right.

shots.kf: A stunning, modern minimalist kitchen interior featuring elegant matte beige cabinets and a thick, premium wooden island. The space is decorated with minimalist elements and filled with bright natural daylight. Wide 24mm lens, precise architectural composition, clean neutral color palette, highly photorealistic interior design.
shots.motion: A slow, smooth cinematic camera track forward towards the beautiful wooden kitchen island, highlighting the clean modern design.

shots.kf: Woman in her 40s, short dark hair, wearing a white linen blouse, stands confidently in the modern kitchen, her hand resting gently on the wooden island. Medium shot, 35mm lens, soft diffused indoor lighting, earthy and warm colors, highly photorealistic and cinematic.
shots.motion: The woman gently slides a hand across the smooth wooden surface as the camera slowly dollies left.

shots.kf: Woman in her 40s, short dark hair, wearing a white linen blouse, sitting comfortably on a high stool at the kitchen island, holding a beautiful ceramic coffee cup. Over-the-shoulder perspective, bright sunny morning illuminating the room, 50mm lens, warm and inviting colors, highly photorealistic and serene atmosphere.
shots.motion: Steam rises slowly from the coffee cup while the camera gently pulls back to reveal the beautiful kitchen.

films.desc_en: A majestic solid walnut dining table is crafted and perfectly placed in a modern dining room.
films.music: Deep, soulful cello with slow cinematic percussion, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Природата крие најубави форми и бои.
Ние им даваме нов, вечен живот.
Масивни маси за вашето семејство.
Место каде се раѓаат спомени.
Трајна убавина од македонско дрво.

shots.kf: Massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs sitting majestically in a rustic, sunlit woodworking studio in North Macedonia. Fine sawdust covers the floor beneath heavy wooden beams. Wide shot, 35mm lens, warm golden hour lighting, rich brown and amber color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance in the golden light as the camera slowly pushes in towards the majestic table.

shots.kf: Close-up of a thick slab of raw walnut wood on a workbench. A heavy steel hand plane rests on top, surrounded by elegant, curly wood shavings. Macro photography, 85mm lens, dramatic directional side lighting, deep amber and charcoal tones, highly photorealistic texture.
shots.motion: A single wood shaving gently flutters as if blown by a light breeze, camera slowly pans left.

shots.kf: Close-up of the massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs, its surface gleaming beautifully with fresh oil. Soft window light reflects elegantly off the polished, rich grain. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm tones, cinematic and highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The reflection of the window light moves smoothly across the oiled wood surface, camera tilts down slightly.

shots.kf: The massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs placed perfectly in a luxurious modern dining room in Skopje. Floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a stunning twilight cityscape. 24mm lens, architectural framing, cool blue and warm orange contrast, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow, elegant camera dolly from left to right, showcasing the table's perfect placement in the room.

shots.kf: The massive live-edge solid walnut dining table with black steel legs, elegantly set with ceramic plates, folded linen napkins, and crystal wine glasses under a warm modern pendant light. 35mm lens, moody atmospheric lighting, sophisticated earthy color palette, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The pendant light swings almost imperceptibly while the camera slowly pushes in towards the table setting.

films.line_mk: Удобност која го трансформира вашиот дневен престој.
films.line_en: Comfort that transforms your living room.
films.desc_en: A fast-paced visual exploration of a luxurious velvet sofa set against stunning nature.
films.music: Upbeat, luxurious electronic lounge with heavy bass, 115 bpm
vo_mk: Удобност која го трансформира вашиот дневен престој.

shots.kf: Plump, luxurious emerald green velvet sofa centered in a modern minimalist photography studio. Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. A heavy silk decorative cushion is suspended in mid-air just above the plush seat. 35mm lens, soft studio lighting, rich green and gold palette, incredibly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The cushion drops slowly onto the velvet sofa, creating a soft bounce, while the camera remains static.

shots.kf: Extreme close-up of the plush emerald green velvet fabric of the luxurious sofa. Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. Macro lens capturing individual fibers, dramatic directional lighting highlighting the soft texture, deep green tones with golden highlights, highly photorealistic and tactile, inviting the viewer to reach out and touch it.
shots.motion: A subtle ripple moves across the luxurious fabric as the lighting shifts, and the camera slowly dollies in.

shots.kf: The emerald green velvet sofa positioned perfectly in a stunning living room with a massive vertical window framing the dramatic rocky cliffs of Matka Canyon. Vertical 9:16 portrait composition. 24mm lens, natural daylight, contrasting deep green and cool grey stone colors, photorealistic interior.
shots.motion: Slow, smooth camera push-in towards the sofa against the magnificent canyon backdrop, emphasizing the grand scale.

films.desc_en: A single, coherent Skopje story: one recurring craftsperson measures a real apartment wall, designs on a tablet, cuts panels on a CNC, installs, and reveals the finished built-in wardrobe. Same room and same angle for before/after transformation. North Macedonian texture, no signage, no generic stock feel.
films.music: Warm Balkan-modern downtempo with light percussion and soft analog synth, 100 bpm
vo_mk: Прво мериме прецизно, во вашиот дом.
Потоа го цртаме плакарот, по мерка.
Во работилница сечеме точно, без отстапки.
На монтажа, сè влегува како ракавица.
Плакар по мерка. Твој.

shots.kf: Interior, real Skopje apartment bedroom near the Vardar quay: same pale warm-grey wall, light oak floor, one small window with sheer curtain, soft morning daylight. A single hero craftsperson (male, early 30s, short dark hair, clean-shaven, charcoal hoodie, black work pants) measures the wall niche with a metal tape and pencil marks. 28mm lens, eye-level, natural color palette (oak, beige, graphite), photorealistic, no readable text.
shots.motion: He pulls the measuring tape to full width and taps the wall mark once; camera makes a gentle left-to-right dolly of 40 cm, keeping the niche centered, steady and realistic over 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Same bedroom, same wall niche and floor, same hero and outfit. He kneels by a simple wooden stool holding a tablet; on-screen is a clean 3D wardrobe model with compartments and sliding doors (no text, no logos). Morning light still soft and consistent, subtle reflections on the screen. 35mm lens, medium close-up on hands/face and tablet, shallow depth of field, warm neutral palette, photorealistic, clear simple facial features.
shots.motion: He drags one finger to rotate the 3D model and nods once; camera performs a slow push-in of about 30 cm toward the tablet, keeping his hands and screen in sharp focus for 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Small woodworking workshop in Skopje Old Bazaar backstreets, signage-free: textured plaster walls, worn concrete floor, stacked MDF sheets, warm overhead bulbs mixed with daylight from a high window. Same hero (same clothes) stands at a CNC router, guiding placement of an MDF panel while the machine head hovers ready. 24mm lens, three-quarter wide shot, gritty warm-brown palette with graphite accents, photorealistic, no readable markings.
shots.motion: He slides the MDF sheet flush to the machine stops and presses a single large unlabeled button; camera tilts down slightly then tracks right 30 cm to follow the CNC head beginning a smooth cut, plausible in 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Back in the same Skopje bedroom, same wall niche, same oak floor, same window and morning light now slightly brighter. The hero installs: one vertical side panel is already anchored; he holds a sliding track and aligns it carefully at the top edge with a compact drill-driver (no logos). 35mm lens, medium shot from the same side angle as shot 1, warm neutral palette, photorealistic, hands clear and unambiguous.
shots.motion: He drives two screws in a controlled motion and checks alignment with a quick glance; camera makes a slow upward tilt from his hands to the top track, ending on the track line over 5 seconds.

shots.kf: Same bedroom, identical camera position and framing as shot 1: the wall niche is now transformed into a finished floor-to-ceiling built-in wardrobe in matte warm-beige with slim black trim. The hero stands to the side, then gently slides one door open to reveal neat shelves (no visible text). Soft morning daylight, calm warm palette, photorealistic, minimal decor unchanged, no logos or signage.
shots.motion: He slides the door fully open in one smooth movement and rests his hand on the handle edge; camera performs a slow pull-back of 40 cm to reveal the full wardrobe face, steady within 5 seconds.
shots.end_kf: Same bedroom, same angle: finished built-in wardrobe fully visible, door left half-open showing shelves; the hero steps out of frame leaving the clean, seamless wardrobe as the final hero object. Morning light consistent, warm neutral palette, photorealistic, no readable text or logos.

films.desc_en: A single coherent transformation: one Skopje apartment living room goes from empty to fully furnished, piece by piece, guided by one recurring hero. Same room, same palette, same camera axis; only the meaningful changes happen. Subtle Skopje context through light and architecture—no signage, no logos, no generic stock feel.
films.music: Warm Balkan-inspired modern beat with light percussion and strings, 92 bpm
vo_mk: Ова беше само празна соба.
Прво, основата: удобна софа.
Потоа масичка, тепих, светло — сè се вклопува.
Последно: детали што носат топлина.
Дом по мерка.

shots.kf: Photorealistic interior of a real Skopje apartment living room, empty but clean: pale warm plaster walls, oak parquet, one large window with sheer curtains and soft morning haze; outside only blurred Vardar-quay trees and concrete blocks, no readable text. Static eye-level wide shot, 24mm lens, gentle natural light, muted beige and oak palette, a single wall outlet visible, no decor yet.
shots.motion: A young woman (late 20s) in a plain cream sweater and dark jeans steps in from frame left, measures the wall with a folded tape measure, then looks to the empty corner. Camera makes a slow 10 cm push-in on tripod, steady and realistic.
shots.end_kf: Same room, same framing and light; still empty, but a discreet pencil mark and a small folded tape measure now rest on the floor near the wall, indicating planning without changing anything else.

shots.kf: Same Skopje living room, identical camera position and morning light, 24mm lens. The woman appears in the same cream sweater and dark jeans, hair tied back the same way. The room is still mostly empty; only the tape measure on the floor remains. Color palette stays warm neutral: beige walls, oak floor, soft grey shadows, no readable text or logos anywhere.
shots.motion: She drags in a modular light-beige sofa from off-screen right, rotates it carefully into position against the back wall, and sits briefly to test it. Camera performs a slow pan right-to-left of about 15 degrees, then settles back to center, all in one continuous move.
shots.end_kf: Same room and angle; the sofa now sits centered against the back wall, cushions neatly placed, all other surfaces still bare and undecorated, maintaining the minimal staged look.

shots.kf: Same exact living room and framing, photorealistic 24mm lens, soft morning light through sheers. The woman, unchanged wardrobe and hair, kneels in front of the sofa. The sofa is present; the rest remains empty. Warm beige, oak, and soft grey palette continues; no signage, no readable labels, no logos. Hands and face are simple and clear, natural expression.
shots.motion: She unrolls a textured off-white rug toward camera and slides a small round oak coffee table into the center, aligning it with the sofa. Camera stays low and makes a smooth tilt down from sofa height to the rug, ending on the table’s placement.
shots.end_kf: Same angle; rug is fully laid flat with clean edges, the round oak coffee table is centered on it, perfectly aligned with the sofa, while the walls and corners remain intentionally uncluttered.

shots.kf: Same Skopje living room, identical camera placement and 24mm lens; the daylight is slightly warmer as if late morning, still soft and realistic. The woman in the same cream sweater and dark jeans stands near the corner by the window. Sofa, rug, and coffee table remain. The palette stays cohesive: beige, oak, off-white, and a single muted olive accent pillow now visible but subtle.
shots.motion: She lifts a slim oak floor lamp into place beside the sofa, then hangs a single framed abstract print (no text) on the wall using the earlier pencil mark. Camera performs a gentle handheld-style micro-dolly left about 20 cm, stabilizing at the end to feel intimate and real.
shots.end_kf: Same room and composition; floor lamp stands beside the sofa, the abstract frame is level on the wall, and one muted olive pillow rests on the sofa, adding a restrained accent without changing anything else.

shots.kf: Same living room, same camera axis and 24mm lens, now with warm late-afternoon sun stripes across the oak parquet, still photorealistic and natural. The woman, same outfit and hairstyle, places final touches on the coffee table. Sofa, rug, table, lamp, and abstract frame are all present. No readable text, no logos, no signage; outside window remains soft and indistinct.
shots.motion: She sets a ceramic vase with dried wild grasses on the coffee table, steps back, and exhales with a small satisfied smile. Camera locks into a slow, steady push-in of about 25 cm toward the finished seating area, ending on the balanced composition.
shots.end_kf: Exact same framing and room; the finished setup is complete: sofa with one olive pillow, centered rug and oak table, floor lamp, and one abstract frame, with the vase as the final focal detail—cozy, cohesive, and unmistakably real.
